digest.component_or_area: CI/CD and dependency management (GitHub Actions workflows, Python lock and constraints)
propositions: GitHub is a read-only mirror and dependabot PRs cannot merge directly; PR #123 and #124 must be re-landed as Gerrit changes and the PRs closed by hand
PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python v6→v7 (new SHA) and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish, affecting 13 workflow files and two allowlist echo lines

PR #124 upgrades mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0 (major version, loosening pyproject constraint from <2 to <3) and ruff 0.15.22→0.16.1, creating risk of breaking API imports in mcp_server.py, _mcp_auth.py, and _mcp_models.py
click 8.2.1 has a command-injection CVE (PYSEC-2026-2132); a P0 Gerrit change must bump click to >=8.3.3 in uv.lock FIRST to unblock all other changes through the pip-audit gate

mcp 2.0 breaks structural compatibility: FastMCP class is removed from mcp.server.fastmcp, forcing Path 2 (defer mcp v2 migration to follow-up ticket 732b-51df-acf2-477b, land ruff 0.16.1 only, keep mcp constraint <2)
All three Gerrit changes (1238, 1244, 1245) have merged with Verified +1; PRs #123 and #124 closed on GitHub with provenance comments; AC0–AC4 met and ticket complete
